tasks.subject: Task 1: supports_redirect and the two generated artifacts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** In redirect mode NginxTarget emits an allow-list map plus a server-context location that proxies to GitHub with a token it never writes.

**Verify:** just test tests/test_targets.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ghr_pypi/targets/nginx.py", "tests/test_targets.py"], "verifyCommand": "just test tests/test_targets.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["supports_redirect is True", "redirect mode emits both conf files, other modes only the first", "nothing written to out_dir", "map keyed on /_assets/<id>/<filename>, valued with the API path", "sidecar gets its own .metadata key resolving to the sidecar id", "no .metadata key without a sidecar", "colliding asset id raises RedirectError", "no token or password in generated output", "auth_basic realm is a fixed literal, not site.title", "proxy_pass targets index.API_ROOT", "commented index-page auth stanza present", "map_hash_bucket_size addressed with a measured justification or omitted with reason"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: a live nginx run
tasks.description:

**Verify:** just test tests/test_nginx_live.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/test_nginx_live.py"], "verifyCommand": "just test tests/test_nginx_live.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["skips cleanly with a reason when nginx is absent", "nginx -t accepts the generated pair", "allow-listed asset returns the upstream 302 with Location intact", "URI not in the map returns 404", "no credentials returns 401", "the upstream Authorization appears in no client-visible response", "a .metadata URI resolves to the sidecar id not the wheel id", "the stub upstream records the Authorization it received"]}
```
